---
title: "Seasons"
---

```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(ggridges)

mallards <- readRDS("data/mallards.rds")
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 7

mallards |>
  filter(!is.na(speed), speed <= 30) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = speed, y = month, fill = after_stat(x))) +
  geom_density_ridges(
    scale = 1.1,
    rel_min_height = 0.01,
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma", name = "Speed (m/s)") +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(month.name)) +
  labs(
    title = "Mallard Speed Distributions by Month",
    subtitle = "GPS movement speeds filtered to 30 m/s or less",
    x = "Speed (m/s)",
    y = "Month"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```
